summary: Preserve bounded catalog and SEC workflows with origin-bound credentials, atomic searchable snapshots, complete pagination accounting, and accurate MCP permissions.
reason: The catalog APIs expose different metadata and pagination shapes; SEC requires a contact User-Agent, explicit filing bounds, and exact XBRL units and periods. Local snapshot analysis must not imply full-catalog completeness or deletions. Explicit profile logout must remain logged out without deleting shared global credentials; save reporting must use the actual selected credential route.
validated_outcome: Printing Press 4.35.1; full unit suite and vet passed; race checks across five core packages passed; 183/183 executed live checks passed (141 skipped/unverified); separate both-source capture, typed offline search, and stdout manifest lifecycle passed; publish validation passed.
